Doch dieser tappt nicht in die Falle. Da entschließt sich Jeanette zu einem radikalen Schritt, mit allen Konsequenzen... Merle konfrontiert Justus mit dem gestohlenen Bild in seinem Koffer. Betroffen gibt er alles zu, beschwört Merle, dass seine Gefühle für sie echt sind. Doch Merle wirft ihn hinaus. Bevor sie jedoch Gunter reinen Wein einschenken kann, erlebt sie eine Überraschung. Aylin und Thomas geraten bei ihrer Hochzeitsplanung zunehmend in Stress. Die Erwartungen von Aylins Familie und der riesige Familien- und Bekanntenkreis sprengen den Rahmen dessen, was Thomas für tragbar hält. Als es schließlich zum Streit kommt, erkennen beide schnell, dass sie sich in einer Sackgasse befinden. Um Frauke zu beeindrucken, büffelt Theo Allgemeinwissen. Und bemüht sich intensiv um einen besseren Standort für die Würstchenbude.

skydrama.uk.title: Cookster: The Darkest Days (2024)

skydrama.uk.title: Wish You Were Here (2025)

skygreats.uk.title: The Breakfast Club (1985)
skygreats.uk.description: Five school kids - an athlete, a spoiled rich kid, a brainy nerd, an introverted loner and a rebellious punk - are brought together on a day-long detention where they break the rules, bare their souls and find they have more in common than just attending the same high school. (Comedy / Comedy drama) - 1985

skygreats.uk.title: Blazing Saddles (1974)
skygreats.uk.description: Irreverent spoof about a black sheriff hired by a crooked speculator to drive citizens out of an all-white town which lies in the path of a railroad. The townspeople turn on the inexperienced sheriff, and he is forced to turn to a convict, once the fastest gun in the West, for help. (Comedy / Western) - 1974

skygreats.uk.title: Jerry Maguire (1996)
skygreats.uk.description: A sports agent who makes the mistake of saying what he believes, finds himself sacked and abandoned by all his clients apart from small time footballer Rod Tidwell. Maguire's personal life starts to fall apart as he's torn between love and money in Cameron Crowe's metaphor on Americans' need for success and money. (Drama / Romantic comedy) - 1996

skythriller.uk.title: The Hunt for Red October (1990)
skythriller.uk.description: Soviet and American forces give chase when the captain of a Soviet nuclear submarine sets a course for the Maine coast. (Action / Adventure / Thriller) - 1990

skythriller.uk.title: Dog Day Afternoon (1975)
skythriller.uk.description: A desperate and crazed man, with the help of an accomplice, takes a local Brooklyn bank hostage with plans to rob it in order to pay for his lover's sex-change operation. (Crime drama / Gay/lesbian) - 1975

skythriller.uk.title: The Perfect Storm (2000)
skythriller.uk.description: Seafaring drama based on the true story of a commercial fishing boat crew who become caught in a terrifying storm off the coast of Massachusetts. In the autumn of 1991, a fishing boat captain is determined to set sail despite the adverse weather conditions, but when the ice machine breaks down his decision to brave the storm rather than lose his catch results in a battle against 100ft waves. (Action / Adventure / Drama / Thriller) - 2000

HubPremier1.sg.title: PL MOMENTS
HubPremier1.sg.description: PL MOMENTS With 481 Premier League appearances and five titles – Michael Carrick is a Premier League icon. Carrick sits down with Premier League Moments to look back over his glittering career – from the West Ham youth academy through to being a key figure in Sir Alex's Ferguson's Manchester United side. In addition to his Premier League career, he also reflects on winning the Champions League, Europa League, the FA Cup as well as his international career.

HubPremier1.sg.title: PL STORIES
HubPremier1.sg.description: PL STORIES From his family's courageous journey in search of a better future to becoming one of Europe's most respected midfielders, this is the story of Granit Xhaka. We chart his rise through the game, the highs and lows of a career that tested his resilience, and the turbulent relationship with Arsenal supporters that ultimately became one of football's greatest redemption stories. Now in love with the game again at Sunderland, Xhaka's story proves that perseverance can define a legacy as much as succes.
